rex_fm_001.speaker: rex_hollowell
rex_fm_001.text: Don't touch the merchandise until you've paid. Basic rule. You look like you've survived a few things — what do you need?

choices.text: I'm looking to trade. What do you have?
I saw the posting. The silo job. What's the rate?
[Barter 40] I know what things are worth out here. Don't try to gouge me.

rex_fm_002a.speaker: rex_hollowell
rex_fm_002a.text: Ammo, medical basics, a couple of weapons I liberated from people who no longer needed them. Caps or trade. I don't do credit.

rex_fm_002b.speaker: rex_hollowell
rex_fm_002b.text: The Covenant has at least a squad in there. Maybe more. Rate is three hundred caps plus a ten percent cut of whatever you pull out. Non-negotiable — I've done the scouting already.

rex_fm_003_silo.speaker: rex_hollowell
rex_fm_003_silo.text: One more thing. Whatever that signal is — somebody wants it kept quiet. I've had two people ask me not to talk about it in the last week. That tells me it's worth finding.

rex_fm_002c_pass.speaker: rex_hollowell
rex_fm_002c_pass.text: *studies you* You've been around. Fair enough. Union discount — fifteen percent off posted prices. Don't tell anyone.

rex_fm_002c_fail.speaker: rex_hollowell
rex_fm_002c_fail.text: Posted prices are what they are. You want it, pay for it. You don't, walk on.
